hardwareNote: No barometer sensor present on this machine; both scenarios' terminal behavior is Status='No barometer found' and hPa output stays 'No data'. Barometer.GetDefault() returns null, so button handlers only re-notify the error.

scenarios.title: Data Events

mustHave.description: Registers an event listener for barometer data and displays the pressure in hPa values as they are reported.
outputs: Status: No barometer found (shared status block)

scenarios.behavior: With a sensor: Enable registers ReadingChanged and streams hPa; Disable stops it. With no sensor (this machine): constructor notifies 'No barometer found'; Enable/Disable produce no new pressure output.

scenarios.title: Polling

mustHave.description: Polls for barometer data and displays the pressure in hPa values.
outputs: Status: No barometer found (shared status block)

scenarios.behavior: With a sensor: Get Data reads current pressure into hPa. With no sensor (this machine): Get Data notifies 'No barometer found'.

scoring.pass: Scenario reachable, all controls present, visuals match UWP golden, correct hardware-gated status shown.
scoring.partial: Reachable but missing controls or a control live in UWP is dead in WinUI.
scoring.fail: Blank/unreachable, dropped scenario, or every frame blank including after actuation.
